_comment: Synthetic. Session.Info as returned by GET /api/session/:sessionID ({data: <this>}) and in GET /api/session list items. Schema from binary: id, parentID?, fork?{sessionID,boundary}, projectID, agent?, model?{id,providerID,variant}, cost, tokens, outcome? ('succeeded'|'failed'|'interrupted'), time{created,updated,busy?,idle?,viewed?,archived?} (epoch ms), title?, location{directory,...}, subpath?, metadata?, permissions?, revert?. No client/origin field exists.
